hypothesis: Qualifying an initial one-pixel stencil may reduce strict frozen-domain line-search failures without dropping observations during the solve; it may instead remove too much support
data_role: already viewed development; initial margin local comparison only
initial_state: Exactly the same saved initial poses, node timestamps and original incoming priors as the preceding continuous experiment
initial_margin: For every source retained by the parent continuous selector, require qualification at all nine target projections with du,dv in {-1,0,1} layer pixels, holding target optical axial Z fixed
probe_qualification: Original four-corner depth/normal bounds and depth continuity, finite gradient, source-normal/gradient dot>0.8 and 3D distance<0.08m at scale1
stencil_scope: A finite nine-probe heuristic, not a guarantee over all intermediate coordinates, depth changes or rotations; all original candidate-domain guards remain active
population: Subset initial source observations only, require at least 200 surviving observations per admitted raw factor; freeze the selected sources for the entire attempt
normalizers: Carry each surviving source's original center normalizer unchanged; do not use probe normalizers as new measurements or weights
objective_and_guards: Unchanged continuous inverse-depth residual, exact derivative, prior chart, ownership, scaled SPD condition<=1e6, 0.1m/0.15rad proposal limits and eight Armijo candidates 1..1/128; no damping, rank filling or per-candidate source removal
convergence: Unchanged full continuous proposal below strict1e-5m/1e-5rad per nonorigin node; original-discrete fresh convergence separately reported
control: Complete preceding continuous reports from identical starting poses and priors, independently rechecked against original source support
comparison_limits: Different initial source subsets prevent direct cost/RMS comparison of continuous objectives; no timing, physical-accuracy or domain-guarantee inference
independent_checks: Relative-camera homogeneous pixel offsets and array intersections with polynomial interpolation/SVD normals; only initial selection is replaced in a private unchanged continuous verifier; source proof of identical solver body and shared unchanged objective/search helpers
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must converge all five continuous windows, improve original-discrete fresh-converged count, have no local or fresh guards, pass original0.03m RMS gates and have original-discrete median RMS no worse than control
scope: No full-trajectory evaluation or default tracker integration in this local comparison
